title: Reporting Delivery Configuration
description: Desired durable reporting delivery for one account. Entries are owned by (authenticated caller, account) and keyed by delivery_config_id. A method destination either requests provisioning from non-secret coordinates or reuses a seller-issued binding. sync_accounts replacement semantics apply only to the calling principal's set. Omission leaves that set unchanged; [] removes that caller's set and MUST NOT affect another caller. Sellers implementing this schema MUST advertise media_buy.reporting_delivery in experimental_features.

delivery_config_id.description: Caller-selected stable identifier, unique within the authenticated caller and account.

active.description: Whether new reporting obligations should use this configuration. Inactive configurations remain visible for historical resolution.

feed_purpose.description: Operational use of this independently reconciled feed. pacing is the fast snapshot path; billing is invoice-authoritative; exposure is permitted only when the reporting profile authorizes event-level data.

reporting_profile.description: Versioned semantic profile for the report, such as media_buy_delivery_v1 or an explicitly authorized exposure-log profile.

scope.description: Media buys covered by this configuration.

required_finality.description: Finality the durable path must ultimately provide. Snapshot delivery may still precede an official requirement.
